# Bazozo

> Bazozo Studio is a Product & Engineering Studio based in India, serving clients worldwide (remote). Four core pillars: Web & E-Commerce (custom web, WordPress, Shopify/headless, speed & SEO); Browser Extensions & Plugins (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, WordPress plugins); Cross-Platform Apps (iOS, Android, macOS & Windows utilities, mobile games); Brand Film & Motion (video editing, interactive scroll & WebGL).

## Contact
- Email: hello@bazozo.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 73475 00770
- Location: India (remote, worldwide clients)
- [Contact page](https://bazozo.in/#contact)

## Services
SEO & technical SEO, website migration, website redesign, performance optimization, e-commerce development, CMS development, landing page design, UI/UX design, web app development, API integration, progressive web apps, accessibility audits, security hardening, analytics & tracking, conversion rate optimization, hosting & domain setup, website maintenance, multilingual localization, legacy system modernization.

## Disciplines
Websites, video editing, Chrome extensions, Firefox Add-ons, Safari App Extensions, WordPress Plugins, Android apps, iOS apps, Windows Applications, macOS Applications, Android games, iOS games.

## Frequently asked questions
- What does Bazozo build? Custom websites and e-commerce, browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Manifest V3), WordPress plugins, iOS and Android apps, Windows and macOS utilities, mobile games, and brand films / motion graphics.
- Where is Bazozo based? India. The studio works remotely with clients worldwide, in English, Hindi and Punjabi.
- How is a project priced? A written quote with scope, milestones and timeline before work starts; an advance plus milestone payments; out-of-scope work is quoted first.
- Are the portfolio projects real? Baaz Records (baazrecords.in) is a live client site. Most other portfolio pieces are working, interactive concept builds made by Bazozo Studio to demonstrate each discipline; brands inside them are fictional.
- Who owns the code? The client, once the project is paid in full.
- [All questions and answers](https://bazozo.in/#faq)
